tools.description: Publish an Ed25519 assertion key (Multikey) so credentials this ID issues carry a proof other DID methods can verify.

tools.description: Publish an X25519 key-agreement key (and optional DIDCommMessaging service) to the current ID.

tools.name: archon_unpublish_didcomm
tools.description: Remove the DIDComm key-agreement key and service from the current ID.

tools.name: archon_pack_didcomm
tools.description: Pack a DIDComm v2 message (encrypted, optionally signed) for one or more recipient DIDs.

tools.name: archon_unpack_didcomm
tools.description: Unpack (decrypt and verify) a DIDComm v2 message addressed to the current ID.

tools.name: archon_send_didcomm
tools.description: Pack a DIDComm message and deliver it to each recipient DID's mailbox.

tools.name: archon_receive_didcomm
tools.description: Fetch and unpack queued DIDComm messages from the current ID's mailbox. Acknowledges (removes) them unless ack is false.

tools.name: archon_ack_didcomm
tools.description: Acknowledge (remove) DIDComm messages from the current ID's mailbox by id.

tools.name: archon_send_credential_didcomm
tools.description: Deliver an issued credential over DIDComm. Unlike send_credential, this reaches subjects whose DID is not a did:cid, because it carries the credential itself rather than a reference.

tools.name: archon_accept_credential_didcomm
tools.description: Accept a credential received over DIDComm into the wallet. Returns false for a credential from a foreign issuer, which has no did:cid to resolve.

tools.name: archon_mediate_didcomm
tools.description: Relay queued Forward envelopes from this ID's mailbox to their recipients (mediator role).
